title: Compatible OR disjunct range combination

scope.rationale: The WHERE planner now recognizes compatible equal-operand disjuncts, duplicates one expression, normalizes the combined range operator, inserts a dynamic virtual term, and analyzes it.
excluded_responsibilities: Pinned-C planner trace and independent review remain open.

external_source_responsibilities: Exact AST or Btree cursor ownership supplied by caller
dependencies.caller_closure: Every assigned source body is complete behind typed ownership boundaries; remaining public/compiler callers are explicit blockers.

inputs: FROM source list, owning WhereClause, two analyzed disjunct terms, and the source analyze-term continuation
outputs: At most one owned dynamic virtual term analyzed in the parent clause
contracts.ownership: Duplicated expression transfers to WhereClause on insertion; failed insertion consumes it through the dynamic-term contract.
contracts.state_and_results: VNULL/non-comparison/mixed-direction/different-operand/different-commutation terms are unchanged. Compatible terms normalize to EQ, LE, or GE.
contracts.locks_callbacks_io: No I/O or locks; invokes the typed expression-analysis continuation once after successful insertion.
contracts.failure_and_continuation: Duplication/insertion OOM adds no usable term; compatible success leaves normal clause cleanup ownership.

representation_differences: The recursive exprAnalyze call is a typed continuation because that source owner is not yet translated.

oracle.protocol: Construct x<7 OR x=7 and require one dynamic x<=7 term plus one analysis callback; reject VNULL and incompatible families.
internal_observations: Mem flags, encoding, bytes, and scalar representation
continuation after rejected or non-foldable input
oracle.normalization: Compare exact primary result, Mem type/value/bytes, and owned versus ephemeral state.

assurance.oom: Allocation failure publishes NOMEM, null output where required, and preserves releasable Mem ownership.
assurance.io_crash_concurrency: Btree synchronization and I/O are caller/typed-operation responsibilities; literal folding performs no I/O.
assurance.malformed_input: Record bounds, maximum allocation, absent AST children/tokens, and unsupported expressions fail without fabricated values.
assurance.continuation: Successful values remain caller-owned; failed temporary values are released.
assurance.performance: Local payloads remain zero-copy; overflow copies once; literal folding is linear in token/payload size.

integration.native_call_path: WHERE expression analysis calls combineDisjuncts for two-way OR terms once the recursive analyzer owner is connected.
integration.bounded_owner_retired: No substitute source behavior remains inside the assigned helper bodies.

independent_review.notes: Requires pinned-C trace, caller integration, assurance, and independent review.

known_blockers: Pinned-C planner trace and independent review remain open.

Native exact Mem, AST, Btree operation boundary, and callers
callers: VDBE record materialization, virtual-table RHS folding, and WHERE expression analysis
callees: Mem allocation/release/affinity/encoding, AST duplication, Btree payload operations, and term insertion
assertions_branches_cleanup: All source branches, ownership transitions, bounds, operator compatibility, and cleanup paths assigned
upstream_tests: Upstream expression-value, record payload, virtual-table RHS, OR-planner, OOM, and corruption tests
